---
title: Web Features Services(WFS)
# sidebar_position: 2
---

1. **INTRODUCTION**

   The Web Feature Service (WFS) represents a change in the way geographic information is created, modified and exchanged on the Internet. Rather than sharing geographic information at the file level using File Transfer Protocol (FTP), for example, the WFS offers direct fine-grained access to geographic information at the feature and feature property level. Web feature services allow clients to only retrieve or modify the data they are seeking, rather than retrieving a file that contains the data they are seeking and possibly much more. That data can then be used for a wide variety of purposes, including purposes other than their producers' intended ones.

1. **MAIN FEATURES**

- **GetCapabilities** operation generates a service metadata document describing a WFS service provided by a server.
- This is a complete example of ServiceMetadata response with RESTful and KVP support.

 **GetDescribeFeatureType**
- GetDescribeFeatureType** operation returns a schema description of feature types offered by a WFS instance. The schema descriptions define how a WFS expects feature instances to be encoded on input (via Insert, Update and Replace actions) and how feature instances shall be encoded on output (in response to a GetPropertyValue, GetFeature or GetFeatureWithLock operation).

- Example respone 

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsd:schema elementFormDefault="qualified" targetNamespace="http://vbdmapv3_OGC" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:vbdmapv3_OGC="http://vbdmapv3_OGC" xmlns:wfs="http://www.opengis.net/wfs/2.0" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
    <xsd:import namespace="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" schemaLocation="http://schemas.opengis.net/gml/3.2.1/gml.xsd"/>
    <xsd:complexType name="region_vnparkType">
        <xsd:complexContent>
            <xsd:extension base="gml:AbstractFeatureType">
                <xsd:sequence>
                    <xsd:element maxOccurs="1" minOccurs="0" name="geom" nillable="true" type="gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType"/>
                </xsd:sequence>
            </xsd:extension>
        </xsd:complexContent>
    </xsd:complexType>
    <xsd:element name="region_vnpark" substitutionGroup="gml:AbstractFeature" type="vbdmapv3_OGC:region_vnparkType"/>
</xsd:schema>

```

**GetFeaute**
- **GetFeaute** operation returns a selection of features from a data store. A WFS processes a GetFeature request and returns a response document to the client that contains zero or more feature instances that satisfy the query expressions specified in the request.
- **Example request (Arcgis Pro)**
```xml
<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
  <GetFeature xmlns:ogc='http://www.opengis.net/ogc' xmlns:fes='http://www.opengis.net/fes/2.0' xmlns:gml='http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2' xmlns:wfs='http://www.opengis.net/wfs/2.0' xmlns='http://www.opengis.net/wfs/2.0' xmlns:vbdmapv3\_OGC='http://vbdmapv3\_OGC' version='2.0.0' service='WFS' resultType='results' count='10'>
  <Query typeNames='vbdmapv3\_OGC:region\_vnpark' srsName='urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326'>
    <PropertyName>geom</PropertyName>
    <fes:Filter>
       <fes:BBOX>
         <fes:ValueReference>geom</fes:ValueReference>
         <gml:Envelope srsName="urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326">
           <gml:lowerCorner>10.06412147049197 105.9484663037575</gml:lowerCorner>
           <gml:upperCorner>11.2014291294104 107.5869208738421</gml:upperCorner>
         </gml:Envelope>
       </fes:BBOX>
    </fes:Filter>
  </Query>
  </GetFeature>
  ```

**GetPropertyValue**
- **GetPropertyValue** operation allows the value of a feature property or part of the value of a complex feature property to be retrieved from the data store for a set of features identified using a query expression.

**Transaction**
- **Transacsion** operation is used to describe data transformation operations to be applied to feature instances under the control of a web feature service. Using the Transaction operation clients can create, modify, replace and delete features in the web feature service's data store.
- **Example body transaction request:**
- **Insert:**

  ```xml
  <Transaction xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/wfs" xmlns:vbdmapv3_OGC="http://vbdmapv3_OGC" xsi:schemaLocation="http://vbdmapv3_OGC http://10.222.3.81:8089/vietbando/api/v1/wfs/vbdmapv3_OGC?SERVICE=WFS&amp;REQUEST=DescribeFeatureType&amp;VERSION=1.0.0&amp;TYPENAME=vbdmapv3_OGC:region_vnpark" version="1.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml" service="WFS">

      <Insert xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/wfs">
          <region_vnpark xmlns="http://vbdmapv3_OGC">
              <geom xmlns="http://vbdmapv3_OGC">
                  <gml:MultiPolygon srsName="urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326">
                      <gml:polygonMember>
                          <gml:Polygon>
                              <gml:outerBoundaryIs>
                                  <gml:LinearRing>
                                      <gml:coordinates cs="," ts=" ">106.60625328489201991,10.82369543037038362 106.61367220255542065,10.79739300442946082 106.63256725847939776,10.80376956179049408 106.63534935260317127,10.80376956179049408 106.61900454962599838,10.80843802685148169 106.63059660847505938,10.81982422237838826 106.62480057905052888,10.82665573215309607 106.6072965701884101,10.83348708615736555 106.60625328489201991,10.82369543037038362</gml:coordinates>
                                  </gml:LinearRing>
                              </gml:outerBoundaryIs>
                          </gml:Polygon>
                      </gml:polygonMember>
                  </gml:MultiPolygon>
              </geom>
          </region_vnpark>
      </Insert>
  </Transaction>
  ```

**ServerExternal:**
- **ServerExternal** allows adding more Mapnik servers external and use the parameter "SERVERNAME= XXXX" when make the request.
- *Url:*
```js

GET : http://{{Host}}:{{WFSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wfs?SERVICE=WFS&REQUEST=ServerExternal&NAME={Id}

GET : http://{{Host}}:{{WFSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wfs?SERVICE=WFS&REQUEST=ServerExternal

POST : http://{{Host}}:{{WFSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wfs?SERVICE=WFS&REQUEST=ServerExternal

DELETE : http://{{Host}}:{{WFSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wfs?SERVICE=WFS&REQUEST=ServerExternal&NAME={Id}

```
- *Example body:*
```js
{
    "Id": "mapnik_2",
    "Host": "http://10.222.3.82",
    "Port": "8083"
}
```

(\*)Updating and deleting capabilities can be performed when the ID does not exist in the list of capabilities retrieved from the GetListMaps API.
